2610.08603.title: A Swarm-Coordinated Multi-Robot System for Early Stress Detection in Agricultural Rows Using Multimodal Leaf Sensing
2610.08603.paper_summary: Early stress detection in crops is a necessity today to improve efficiency and reduce waste of time, money, and effort. However, most modern techniques, such as hyperspectral imaging and AI-based systems, are too costly and complex for medium and small-scale farmers to implement. This paper showcases CropSentry, a low-cost, ground-based multi-robot system that uses multimodal leaf sensing to continuously monitor crop health by tracking stress levels. The system comprises two autonomous bots that continuously detect leaf color and environmental data row by row. The observations are spatially mapped and sent over to the master bot, which uses color-coded row segments to generate a real-time web-based dashboard displaying crop health. After 63 observations were collected during the experiments, the results showed an overall crop health classification accuracy of 84.12%, with 82.60% for healthy plants, 88% for nutrient-deficient plants, and 80% for diseased plants. Also, 100% wireless communication success rate across 10 slave observations was achieved. Close-range leaf inspection across multiple bots can detect early stress in crops while remaining affordable, accessible, and scalable. It provides farmers with timely information to improve resource utilization and crop management.
2610.08603.paper_summary_zh: 早期檢測作物壓力在今天是提高效率和減少時間、金錢和努力浪費的必要條件。<lb/>然而，大多數現代技術，如高光譜成像和基於人工智慧的系統，對中小型農民來說過於昂貴和複雜。<lb/>本文展示了CropSentry，一種低成本的地面多機器人系統，利用多模態葉片感測技術持續監測作物健康，通過追蹤壓力水平。<lb/>該系統由兩個自主機器人組成，這些機器人逐行持續檢測葉片顏色和環境數據。<lb/>觀測結果被空間映射並發送到主機器人，主機器人使用顏色編碼的行段生成實時的基於網頁的儀表板，顯示作物健康狀況。<lb/>在實驗中收集了63次觀測後，結果顯示整體作物健康分類準確率為84.12%，健康植物為82.60%，缺乏養分的植物為88%，而病害植物為80%。<lb/>此外，在10次從屬觀測中實現了100%的無線通信成功率。<lb/>多機器人的近距離葉片檢查能夠檢測作物的早期壓力，同時保持經濟實惠、可及性和可擴展性。<lb/>它為農民提供及時的信息，以改善資源利用和作物管理。
